scripts.text:

scripts.text:

path of inner peace and enlightenment.

scripts.text:

scripts.text:

Please, try not to disturb the other monks.
Even if you are a monk yourself.
scripts.translation:

请不要打扰其他武僧。
即使你自己也是武僧。

scripts.text:

this holy building! ! !
Where is your respect?!
scripts.translation:

这座神圣的建筑！！！

scripts.text:
[Tohobu]

scripts.translation:
[托霍布]

scripts.text:

You may learn something...

scripts.text:
[Tohobu]

他在这栋建筑的东南部。

scripts.text:
[Tohobu]
I look forward to seeing you become a monk and joining us.
scripts.translation:
[托霍布]
期待你成为武僧并加入我们。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Greetings, you seem to be on a pure path.
Come in, come in, what can I do for you today?
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
问候你，你似乎走在纯洁的道路上。
进来，进来，今天我能为你做什么？

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
If you have free skill points, you will lose them during a job change.
Make sure to use any skill points you have.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
如果你还有剩余的技能点，在转职时将会丢失。
确保使用掉你所有的技能点。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
I sense a fighting spirit, do you wish to become a monk?
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
我感受到了战斗的精神，你想成为武僧吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
My apologies... It has been some time since
I have sensed someone with your strength.
I hope you find your path young one.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
抱歉...我已经很久没有
感受到像你这样力量的人了。
年轻人，希望你能找到自己的道路。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]

A strong young man. I am pleased of your will to join us.
scripts.translation:

scripts.text:

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]

scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
哦，你就是那个想加入我们的新弟子...
好吧，在开始训练之前，有几件事你应该知道。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
We monks are on a path of inner peace and enlightenment.
We strive to bring such peace to all others with great care.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
我们武僧走在内心平静与启蒙的道路上。
我们小心翼翼地努力将这种平静带给所有人。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
We monks achieve this from mental and physical training.
We search for enlightenment in our surroundings and in nature.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
我们武僧通过精神和身体训练来实现这一点。
我们在周围环境和自然中寻找启蒙。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
It is, of course, important to always keep our original faith in God.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
当然，始终保持对上帝的原始信仰是很重要的。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
This is not an easy life and the true test of becoming a monk is having the ability to endure all of which I said...
The life of a monk is not for everybody, only those strong enough can become a monk.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
这不是轻松的生活，成为武僧的真正考验是拥有忍受我所说的一切的能力...
武僧的生活不适合每个人，只有足够坚强的人才能成为武僧。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Now, that you understand all of this,
prepare yourself to train
your strength and spirit.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
现在，既然你理解了这一切，
准备好训练
你的力量和灵魂吧。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Let us start with a simple task.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]

Why did you return?

20 Yoyo Tail,
5 Iron Ore,
3 Blue Herb.

scripts.translation:

20个溜溜猴尾巴，
5个铁矿石，
3个蓝色药草。

scripts.text:

Hmm?
scripts.translation:

嗯？

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
See, that wasn't so bad you real found all the items.
I will tell this to the elders.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
看，没那么糟吧，你真的找到了所有物品。
我会告诉长老们。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
The next step will be given
to you by Touha.
He is in the north west.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
下一步将由
陶哈给你。
他在西北方。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
How can you think to be done?
You do not have what I asked for!
30 Stem,
5 Jellopy
10 Worm Peelings
These are the items I require, go find them all.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
你怎么能认为完成了？
你没有我要求的东西！
30个植物茎，
5个杰勒比结晶，
10个蚯蚓皮。
这些是我需要的物品，去把它们都找齐。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
I have been waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
我一直在等你。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Impressive, you really found all the items.
I will tell this to the elders.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
令人印象深刻，你真的找到了所有物品。
我会告诉长老们。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Your next step will be with..
elder Touha. Go find him.
He is in the north west.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
你的下一步将是..
陶哈长老。去找他。
他在西北方。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
How can you think to be done?
You do not have what I asked for!
5 Solid Shell,
20 Shell,
5 Zargon.
These are the items I require, go find them all.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
你怎么能认为完成了？
你没有我要求的东西！
5个坚硬外皮，
20个贝壳，
5个刹勒空结晶。
这些是我需要的物品，去把它们都找齐。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Hello again. Back so soon?
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
又见面了。这么快就回来了？

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Very nice, you found all the items.
I will tell this to the elders.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
非常好，你找到了所有物品。
我会告诉长老们。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Let's see who is to see you next..
Ah... go find elder Touha.
He is in the north west.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
让我们看看接下来谁要见你..
啊...去找陶哈长老。
他在西北方。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Where are the items...?
You do not have what I asked for!
5 Cyfar,
10 White Herb,
10 Yellow Herb.
These are the items I require, go find them all.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
物品在哪里...？
你没有我要求的东西！
5个赛依伐，
10个白色药草，
10个黄色药草。
这些是我需要的物品，去把它们都找齐。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Hmm?
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
嗯？

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Excellent, all the items I asked for.
I will tell this to the elders.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
太棒了，所有我要求的物品都齐了。
我会告诉长老们。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Let's see who is to see you next..
Ah... go find elder Touha.
He is in the north west.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
让我们看看接下来谁要见你..
啊...去找陶哈长老。
他在西北方。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
How can you think to be done?
You do not have what I asked for!
10 Tooth of Bat,
5 Bear's Foot skin
20 Poison Spore
These are the items I require, go find them all.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
你怎么能认为完成了？
你没有我要求的东西！
10个蝙蝠牙，
5个熊掌皮，
20个毒魔菇芽孢。
这些是我需要的物品，去把它们都找齐。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Welcome back.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
欢迎回来。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Wow, you found all the items!!
I will tell this to the elders.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
哇，你找到了所有物品！！
我会告诉长老们。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Let's see who is to see you next..
Ah... go find elder Touha.
He is in the north west.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
让我们看看接下来谁要见你..
啊...去找陶哈长老。
他在西北方。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
How can you think to be done?
You do not have what I asked for!
5 Porcupine Quill,
20 Cobweb,
10 Bug Leg.
These are the items I require, go find them all.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
你怎么能认为完成了？
你没有我要求的东西！
5个刺猬尖刺，
20个蜘蛛网，
10个昆虫后脚。
这些是我需要的物品，去把它们都找齐。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
I told you already.
Go find ^CC0000Touha^000000.
He is a little north west of here.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
我已经告诉过你了。
去找 ^CC0000陶哈^000000。
他就在这一带的西北方向。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Oh, are you still in the process of training?
Hurry and finish!
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
哦，你还在训练过程中吗？
快点完成！

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
I hear good things coming from your training.
Good luck and work hard. You will do great things as a monk.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
我听到关于你训练的好消息。
祝你好运，努力工作。你将成为一名伟大的武僧。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
.......Hmmm.....
Go to Tomoon, get a special potion from him. It will look like a green potion, but it isn't. Bring it to me...
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
.......嗯.....
去找托蒙，从他那里得到一种特殊的药水。它看起来像绿色药水，但不是。把它带给我...

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Do you still have the medicine you were supposed to bring?
You must drink that green potion to strengthen yourself for becoming a monk.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
你还拿着应该带来的药吗？
你必须喝下那瓶绿色药水来强化自己，以便成为武僧。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Have you finished the task? Good, so you do have what it takes to become a monk.
You didn't throw away the precious potion did you?
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
你完成任务了吗？很好，看来你确实具备成为武僧的条件。
你没有把那瓶珍贵的药水扔掉吧？

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
The potion you drank earlier must be taking its effect by now.
Now that you drank the potion your training to become a monk will begin shortly...
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
你之前喝下的药水现在应该起作用了。
既然你喝了药水，你成为武僧的训练即将开始...

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
But first, answer me these questions.
Do you dedicate the remainder of your life to the pursuit of purity?
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
但首先，回答我这些问题。
你是否将余生的精力奉献给对纯洁的追求？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
....with that kind of reply...
Have you not enough heart to become a monk?
Do you feel you have not suffered enough?
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
....这样的回答...
你的心还不够成为武僧吗？
你觉得你受的苦还不够多吗？

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Think about it a little more and return!
We cannot accept a monk who is tainted with doubt...
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
再想一想再回来！
我们不能接受一个充满疑虑的武僧...

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Will you take advantage of the abilities gained through our training to use for personal benefit?
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
你会利用通过我们训练获得的能力来谋取个人利益吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
...then we cannot accept you as a monk. We, monks do not practice for personal benefit.
We lead our lives honorably and as holy executioners to the damned.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
...那么我们不能接受你成为武僧。我们武僧不为个人利益而修行。
我们光荣地生活，作为受诅咒者的神圣行刑者。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Go back where you're from and reconsider what it means to be a monk...
How you stand before me now, you will never last as a monk and will be tainted by that which is evil...
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
回到你来的地方，重新思考成为武僧的意义...
以你现在的状态，你永远无法胜任武僧，并会被邪恶所玷污...

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Will you punishing those who are against
veritas and aequitas? ^CCCCCC(Truth and Justice)^000000
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
你会惩罚那些反对
veritas and aequitas ^CCCCCC(真理与正义)^000000 的人吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Who do you think we, the monks are for!
Any creature that is against the will of such spawns from the dregs of the world!
They are not worthy to exist!
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
你以为我们武僧是为了谁！
任何违背这种意志的生物都来自世界的渣滓！
他们不配存在！

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Return when you are ready to face and eliminate that which is evil.
Then you will know what you have to do next without my instructions.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
当你准备好面对并消灭邪恶时再回来。
那时你无需我的指示就知道下一步该做什么。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Will you cooperate with others who have the same goal as yours and sacrifice yourself as a means to an end?
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
你会与有着相同目标的其他人合作，并牺牲自己作为达成目的的手段吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Did you say no...? This is unacceptable...
If you can help your comrades by sacrificing yourself that is a true display of purity.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
你说不...？这是不可接受的...
如果你能通过牺牲自己来帮助同志，那才是纯洁的真正体现。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Go back and contemplate upon what it means to sacrifice yourself for those you care for.
Sacrificing yourself for others may seem easy, but it's the most difficult thing to do as a human being.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
回去思考为你关心的人牺牲自己的意义。
为他人牺牲自己看似容易，但作为人类这是最难做到的事。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Will you assist your comrades by gathering monsters to follow you?
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
你会通过聚集魔物跟随你来协助你的同志吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
That is not acceptable. Purposely taunting monsters to follow you can be very dangerous and harmful to others. This is not the way of a monk.
... that behavior is regarded as careless and is not tolerated.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
这是不可接受的。故意挑衅魔物跟随你可能非常危险并对他人有害。这不是武僧之道。
...这种行为被视为粗心大意，是不被容忍的。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Even though you may be nearly invincible when hardening your body that skill is meant to be used for emergency situation not to be used for such disrespectful use!
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
虽然硬化身体时你可能几乎无敌，但该技能旨在用于紧急情况，而不是用于这种不敬的使用！

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
You might feel that's helping others, but it's not true.
Consider what it is you must do as a monk for others again.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
你可能觉得这是在帮助别人，但事实并非如此。
再次考虑作为武僧你必须为他人做什么。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Will you yell and shout the same things over and over again in towns or in fields?
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
你会在城镇或野外反复大喊大叫同样的事情吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
You are not allowed to do so. This doesn't apply only to monks but to everyone.
Nobody wants their peace disturbed!
Even if you mean well by it, it is disrespectful and not allowed.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
不允许这样做。这不仅适用于武僧，也适用于所有人。
没人希望他们的平静被打扰！
即使你是出于好意，这也是不敬且不被允许的。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Are you willing to die for others on your monk's path of being a holy executioner?
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
你愿意在武僧作为神圣行刑者的道路上为他人而死吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
You cannot become a monk with such an attitude!!!
If we can eliminate at least one more enemy of ours by sacrificing ourselves, that's what is expected of you as a holy executioner in whom we are trained to be.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
持有这种态度你不能成为武僧！！！
如果我们能通过牺牲自己至少再消灭一个敌人，那就是对我们训练成为的神圣行刑者的期望。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
If you are unwilling to sacrifice yourself for those you care about,
how can you expect to reach true enlightenment?
Ponder upon the real meaning of life and death!!
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
如果你不愿意为你关心的人牺牲自己，
你怎么能指望达到真正的启蒙？
深思生与死的真正意义！！

scripts.text: Lastly, make your oath that you will keep these vows.
scripts.translation: 最后，宣誓你将遵守这些誓言。

scripts.text: I vow to keep these oaths.
scripts.translation: 我宣誓遵守这些誓言。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
..............

[Sensei Moohae]
Then your training isn't completed.
You will not be accepted as a monk my boy.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
那么你的训练尚未完成。
孩子，你将不会被接受为武僧。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Then your training isn't completed.
You will not be accepted as a monk little girl.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
那么你的训练尚未完成。
小女孩，你将不会被接受为武僧。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
In light of this, your training will start again from the beginning....
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
鉴于此，你的训练将从头重新开始....

scripts.text:
Calm down yourself... I reconsidered... perhaps you are simply not ready for the commitment yet.
Come back later when you're ready...
scripts.translation:
冷静一下...我重新考虑了...也许你只是还没准备好做出承诺。
等你准备好了再回来...

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
I hope that you are able to realize what you are to become soon my boy...
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
希望我的孩子你能很快意识到你将成为什么...

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
I hope that you are able to realize what you are to become soon my girl...
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
希望我的女孩你能很快意识到你将成为什么...

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Then your training is complete...
Please come closer.
We welcome you brother, in our holy battle against evil!
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
那么你的训练完成了...
请靠近一点。
欢迎你，兄弟，加入我们对抗邪恶的神圣战斗！

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Then your training is complete...
Please come closer.
We welcome you sister, in our holy battle against evil!
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
那么你的训练完成了...
请靠近一点。
欢迎你，姐妹，加入我们对抗邪恶的神圣战斗！

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
My brother, your oath has been heard by all around us.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
我的兄弟，你的誓言已被周围所有人听到。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
My sister, your oath has been heard by all around us.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
我的姐妹，你的誓言已被周围所有人听到。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
I will now perform the ultimate techniques upon your body...
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
我现在将对你的身体施展终极技巧...

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
I will use these ancient techniques to amplify your strength through the use of pressure points on your body.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
我将使用这些古老的技术，通过按压你身体的穴位来增强你的力量。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Close your eyes.........
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
闭上眼睛.........

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
And relax your body.......
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
放松你的身体.......

scripts.text:
[{0}]
^00CCCC- You breathe in deeply -^000000

[{0}]
^CC0000- You feel fingers poking you all over your body with swiftness -^000000
scripts.translation:
[{0}]
^CC0000- 你感觉到手指迅速地戳遍你的全身 -^000000

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Kiiii~~~Yahahhhhhhh!!!
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
Kiiii~~~Yahahhhhhhh!!!

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Ooooohaaa!!!
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
Ooooohaaa!!!

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Kiii~~~Yahahhhhhhh!!!
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
Kiii~~~Yahahhhhhhh!!!

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Haa~ Haa~ Haa~!!!!!
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
Haa~ Haa~ Haa~!!!!!

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
.... now open your eyes......
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
....现在睁开眼睛......

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
....and see life through the eyes of a monk.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
....以武僧的眼光看待生命。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
....You are a monk.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
....你是一名武僧。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
...heh.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
...呵。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Well...I guess I am too old to do that anymore...I was better when I was younger...
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
好吧...我想我太老了，做不了那个了...我年轻时做得更好...

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
...anyways, you are a monk now.
Welcome!
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
...总之，你现在是武僧了。
欢迎！

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
I hope you will keep your vow..
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
希望你能遵守你的誓言..

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
continue your training on your path and practice harder.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
继续在你道路上的训练，更加努力地练习。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Now...you may leave where the wind may take you.
Oh and I have a gift for you before you leave.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
现在...你可以随风而去。
哦，在你离开之前我有一份礼物给你。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
You are...an acolyte..?
If you seek consultation, go to the Sanctuary in Prontera. This place is for Monks, not for you.
Unless you intend to become a monk....please leave.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
你是...服事..？
如果你寻求咨询，去普隆德拉的光耀之堂。这里是给武僧的，不是给你的。
除非你打算成为武僧....请离开。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
How's your practice going?
I hope you are still training and keeping your vows.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
你的练习进展如何？
希望你仍在训练并遵守誓言。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
We must always continue our training in life and stay true to our path.
Otherwise evil will come and taint our mind with impurities.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
我们必须始终在生活中继续训练，忠于我们的道路。
否则邪恶会来临，用杂质玷污我们的思想。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
Don't forget your vows, stay on your path and
do not let any evil taint your pure heart.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
不要忘记你的誓言，坚守你的道路，
不要让任何邪恶玷污你纯爱之心。

scripts.text:
[Sensei Moohae]
If you seek consultation, go to the Sanctuary in Prontera.
We do not have anything of interest to you here, please leave and do not disturb the other monks.
scripts.translation:
[武海师父]
如果你寻求咨询，去普隆德拉的光耀之堂。
我们这里没有你感兴趣的东西，请离开，不要打扰其他武僧。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
What brings you to me.
Do you wish to share a conversation with me?
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
是什么风把你吹到我这里。
你想和我聊聊吗？

scripts.text:
[Touha]
Oh, I see. You're on the monk in training.
You already possess a similar spirit as a monk's.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
哦，我明白了。你是正在训练的武僧。
你已经拥有了类似武僧的精神。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
By the looks of you, it seems, you
have already visited Sensei Moohae. Good.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
看你的样子，似乎
已经见过武海师父了。很好。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
Let me inform you about certain things you must know as a monk.
Then I will help you to strengthen your body so that you can bear your next training.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
让我告诉你作为武僧必须知道的某些事情。
然后我会帮助你强化身体，以便你能承受接下来的训练。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
Calm your mind.
Relax your body...are you ready?
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
平静你的心。
放松你的身体...准备好了吗？

scripts.text: Yes.

scripts.text: No.

scripts.text:
[Touha]
...

[Touha]
Hmm...
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
嗯……

scripts.text:
[Touha]
...well done, that was perfect. You pay attention well...
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
……做得很好，非常完美。你很专心……

scripts.text:
[Touha]
However, now is not the time to relax. Your path is still long ahead of you.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
不过，现在还不是放松的时候。你的道路还很漫长。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
Now as I promised, I will help strengthen your body.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
正如我承诺的，我会帮助你强化身体。

scripts.text: Focus your mind and do not move.
scripts.translation: 集中精神，不要动。

scripts.text: ^33CCFFYou feel wind all around your body.^000000
scripts.translation: ^33CCFF你感到周身环绕着风。^000000

scripts.text: ^33CCFFAn energy within you grows.^000000
scripts.translation: ^33CCFF你体内的能量正在增长。^000000

scripts.text:
[Touha]
I feel what grows within you.
You may now continue on...
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
我感受到了你体内增长的力量。
你可以继续前进了……

scripts.text:
[Touha]
...the next course will be with Boohae.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
……下一关由布海负责。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
I wish you well on your journey.
Don't forget, his name is ^CC0000Boohae^000000.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
祝你旅途顺利。
别忘了，他的名字是^CC0000布海^000000。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
I see you did not pay attention.. If you wish to become a monk, you must take this seriously.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
我看你并没有专心听讲……如果你想成为武僧，就必须认真对待这件事。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
Perhaps the path of a monk is too difficult for you?
You must take this seriously if you wish to continue...
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
也许武僧的道路对你来说太难了？
如果你想继续，就必须认真对待……

scripts.text:
[Touha]
I will give you another chance.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
我再给你一次机会。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
If you cannot pay attention and repeat what I ask you to, I will not allow you to continue your training here..
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
如果你不能专心并复述我要求的内容，我就不允许你在这里继续训练。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
Hmm... did you forget who to visit?
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
嗯……你忘了该去见谁吗？

scripts.text:
[Touha]
I wonder about your abilities if you cannot remember such a simple thing.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
如果你连这么简单的事情都记不住，我真怀疑你的能力。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
...are you testing my patience?
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
……你是在考验我的耐心吗？

scripts.text:
[Touha]
You wear my patience thin...
... go visit Boohae.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
你在消磨我的耐心……
……去见布海吧。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
...do your best for the final test.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
……在最后的测试中尽力而为。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
Never shall innocent blood be shed.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
绝不让无辜者的鲜血流淌。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
Yet the blood of the wicked shall flow like a river.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
但恶人的血将如河流般奔涌。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
We shall spread our blackened wings and be the vengeful striking hammer of god.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
我们将展开漆黑的羽翼，成为上帝复仇的铁锤。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
We shall flow a river forth to thee, and teeming with souls shall it ever be.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
我们将汇成河流奔向你，灵魂将永远充盈其中。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
In nomine Patris, et Filii, et Spiritus Sancti.
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
以父及子及圣灵之名。

scripts.text:
[Touha]
...You don't have to be afraid of me...
scripts.translation:
[陶哈]
……你不必害怕我……

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
...

[Boohae]
......
...excuse me...?
scripts.translation: ……打扰一下……？

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
...
You just interrupted my meditation, I should break your legs...
scripts.translation:
[布海]
...
你刚才打断了我的冥想，我应该打断你的腿……

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
........
I will give you a chance to explain why you interrupted me.
scripts.translation:
[布海]
........
我给你一个解释为什么打断我的机会。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
.....

[Boohae]
Well, start explaining... or you'll be crawling soon...
scripts.translation:
[布海]
好吧，开始解释……否则你很快就要爬着走了……

scripts.text: Touha sent me.
scripts.translation: 陶哈派我来的。

scripts.text: Sorry, nothing.
scripts.translation: 抱歉，没什么事。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
........
...you must have a death wish to have interrupted me intentionally...
scripts.translation:
[布海]
........
……你故意打断我，一定是想死……

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
I see...
Well then, let's see....
scripts.translation:
[布海]
我明白了……
那么，让我们看看……

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
....your body seems..
strengthened. Good...
scripts.translation:
[布海]
……你的身体似乎……
得到了强化。很好……

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
What did you do with Touha?
scripts.translation:
[布海]
你和陶哈做了什么？

scripts.text: Umm... well...ah..
scripts.translation: 嗯……那个……啊……

scripts.text: We recited a holy pledge.
scripts.translation: 我们诵读了一项神圣誓言。

scripts.text: He diagnosed my physical status.
scripts.translation: 他诊断了我的身体状况。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
You are not ready if you
cannot answer a simple question.
Leave me to my prayers.
scripts.translation:
[布海]
如果你连简单的问题都回答不上来，说明你还没准备好。
让我继续祈祷吧。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
... I see...
Didn't he do anything for you?
scripts.translation:
[布海]
……我明白了……
他没为你做什么吗？

scripts.text: Umm... well...ah..
scripts.translation: 嗯……那个……啊……

scripts.text: He diagnosed my physical status.
scripts.translation: 他诊断了我的身体状况。

scripts.text: He taught me about being a monk.
scripts.translation: 他教导了我关于武僧的事。

scripts.text: He modified my body.
scripts.translation: 他改造了我的身体。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
You are not ready if you
cannot answer a simple question.
Leave me to my prayers.
scripts.translation:
[布海]
如果你连简单的问题都回答不上来，说明你还没准备好。
让我继续祈祷吧。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
That is unimportant to me...
Stop disturbing me and go away!
scripts.translation:
[布海]
那对我来说不重要……
别打扰我，走开！

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
The teachings of becoming a monk are learned after becoming one.
This is not what I am looking for...
scripts.translation:
[布海]
成为武僧的教诲是在成为武僧之后学习的。
这不是我要找的……

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
Very well, you seem to realize your body has something new inside.
Well then, we shall move on to the next step...
scripts.translation:
[布海]
很好，看来你意识到身体里有了新的东西。
那么，我们进入下一步……

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
...You interrupted me to tell me that...?
Get lost before I break your legs...
scripts.translation:
[布海]
……你打断我就是为了告诉我这个……？
在我打断你的腿之前滚开……

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
Alright... well we have two tests...
Choose which one you want to do...
scripts.translation:
[布海]
好吧……我们有两项测试……
选择你想做的一项……

scripts.text: Gathering mushrooms
scripts.translation: 采集香菇

scripts.text: Marathon
scripts.translation: 马拉松

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
Hmm....gathering mushrooms. So you want to test your tolerance huh?
Go prepare and come back later when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[布海]
嗯……采集香菇。所以你想测试你的忍耐力，是吗？
去准备吧，准备好了再回来。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
Good choice. Forcing your physical limits to their boundaries and grants a higher amount of self control.
Go prepare and come back later when you're ready.
scripts.translation:
[布海]
不错的选择。将身体极限推向边界能赋予更高的自控力。
去准备吧，准备好了再回来。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
So, are you ready? You won't need anything but a great deal of determination.
scripts.translation:
[布海]
那么，你准备好了吗？除了极大的决心，你不需要任何东西。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
The gathering mushroom test is intended,
to test your patience.
scripts.translation:
[布海]
采集香菇测试旨在
测试你的耐心。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
Go inside the building near this abbey.
scripts.translation:
[布海]
进入这座修道院附近的建筑物。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
Other monk candidates will be with you for the same test,
scripts.translation:
[布海]
其他武僧候选人也将和你一起参加同样的测试，

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
The more people that are there, the less mushrooms they'll find.
So I hope you will understand that they are testing their patience, just like you.
scripts.translation:
[布海]
人越多，找到的香菇就越少。
所以我希望你能理解，他们也在像你一样测试自己的耐心。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
Welcome back, did you prepare? You won't need anything except strong legs.
scripts.translation:
[布海]
欢迎回来，准备好了吗？除了强壮的双腿，你不需要任何东西。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
The marathon is intended,
to test your self-control ability.
scripts.translation:
[布海]
马拉松旨在
测试你的自控能力。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
Go inside the building near this abbey.
scripts.translation:
[布海]
进入这座修道院附近的建筑物。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
All you have to do is run around the building as many times as you're required.
Well... get going.
scripts.translation:
[布海]
你只需要绕着建筑物跑规定的圈数。
好吧……出发吧。

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
Now, go visit 'Tomoon'. How many times should I tell you this?
Now you have a lot of chance to damage your body because you're so exhausted right now.
'Tomoon' is staying in a deepest place inside a building near this abbey.
scripts.translation:
[布海]
现在，去见“托蒙”。我要说多少次你才记得住？
你现在非常疲惫，很容易损伤身体。
“托蒙”待在这座修道院附近建筑物的最深处。

scripts.text: -He seems to be in meditation.-
scripts.translation: -他似乎在冥想。-

scripts.text:
[Boohae]
Hmmmm....!!
-He seems to be in meditation.-
scripts.translation: -他似乎在冥想。-

scripts.text:
[Keeper Chorip]
....this place is for those
 in testing for becoming a monk.
scripts.translation:
[守护者 乔里普]
……这里是给
参加武僧测试的人准备的。

scripts.text:
[Keeper Chorip]
Huh? Did you just say Boohae?
scripts.translation:
[守护者 乔里普]
哈？你刚才说布海？

scripts.text:
[Keeper Chorip]
Boohae... tends to hide in some quite places, so you might not be able to find him. For instance... a corner...
scripts.translation:
[守护者 乔里普]
布海……喜欢躲在安静的地方，所以你可能找不到他。比如……角落……

scripts.text:
[Keeper Chorip]
Is your name {0}?
scripts.translation:
[守护者 乔里普]
你的名字是{0}吗？

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的。

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text:
[Keeper Chorip]
Alright you're cool... go on in. Your test is waiting for you. Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[守护者 乔里普]
好吧，你很不错……进去吧。你的测试在等着你。祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Keeper Chorip]
Yeah right, I know who you are... get in there... your test is ready.
scripts.translation:
[守护者 乔里普]
是的，我知道你是谁……进去吧……你的测试准备好了。

scripts.text:
[Keeper Chorip]
...please be quiet inside.
scripts.translation:
[守护者 乔里普]
……请在里面保持安静。

scripts.text:
[Bashu]
So, which test do you want to do...?
scripts.translation:
[巴修]
那么，你想做哪项测试……？

scripts.text:
[Bashu]
From what I've heard, you chose the mushroom test...
Oh well, it's still your choice.
scripts.translation:
[巴修]
据我所知，你选择了香菇测试……
哦，好吧，这仍然是你的选择。

scripts.text:
[Bashu]
Which test hall do you wish to enter?
scripts.translation:
[巴修]
你想进入哪个测试大厅？

scripts.text:
[Bashu]
Well, as far as I've been told, you chose the marathon test...
Oh well, it's your choice.
scripts.translation:
[巴修]
嗯，据我所知，你选择了马拉松测试……
哦，好吧，这是你的选择。

scripts.text:
[Bashu]
Which test hall do you wish to enter?
You can choose which one you want.
scripts.translation:
[巴修]
你想进入哪个测试大厅？
你可以选择你想要的一个。

scripts.text: Tolerance - Gathering Mushrooms
scripts.translation: 耐力 - 采集香菇

scripts.text: Self-Control - Marathon
scripts.translation: 自控 - 马拉松

scripts.text: You have decided to take the test of tolerance by ^FF0000gathering mushrooms^000000.
scripts.translation: 你决定通过^FF0000采集香菇^000000来进行耐力测试。

scripts.text: You have decided to take the test of self control by taking a ^FF0000marathon^000000.
scripts.translation: 你决定通过参加^FF0000马拉松^000000来进行自控测试。

scripts.text:
[Bashu]
Welcome... this place is a training place for monks, Saint Capitolina Abbey.
When you go inside....you will meet Tomoon the oldest monk who succeeds to the predecessors,
scripts.translation:
[巴修]
欢迎……这里是武僧的训练场所，圣卡波利纳修道院。
当你进去时……你会见到继承前辈衣钵的最年长武僧托蒙，

scripts.text:
[Bashu]
Please be advised and do not touch anything.
And please avoid talking loud in front of Tomoon.
scripts.translation:
[巴修]
请注意，不要触摸任何东西。
并且在托蒙面前请勿大声说话。

scripts.text:
[Bashu]
I hope you will have a great time in here.
scripts.translation:
[巴修]
希望你在这里度过愉快的时光。

scripts.text:
[Monk Apprentice]
W... welcome!
Th... this place is for testing the tolerance of monk candidates!
scripts.translation:
[武僧学徒]
欢……欢迎！
这……这里是测试武僧候选人耐力的地方！

scripts.text:
[Monk Apprentice]
Ju... just run...
until you're told to stop,
Ru...ruu....run!
scripts.translation:
[武僧学徒]
只……只管跑……
直到有人叫你停，
跑……跑……跑！

scripts.text:
[Monk Apprentice]
M... m... me? I'll run one of these days!
scripts.translation:
[武僧学徒]
我……我……我吗？总有一天我也会跑的！

scripts.text:
[Monk Apprentice]
M... monk... are you going to be... a... m...m...monk??
scripts.translation:
[武僧学徒]
武……武僧……你要成为……一……名……武……武僧吗？？

scripts.text:
[Monk Apprentice]
Ar...are...you...sure you are.. aren't... going to quit?
scripts.translation:
[武僧学徒]
你……确定……你……不会……放弃吗？

scripts.text: Quit.
scripts.translation: 退出。

scripts.text: Keep running.
scripts.translation: 继续跑。

scripts.text:
[Monk Apprentice]
{0}...q.q..q. .quit! ...the marathon!! Y...you do not have what it takes to be a m... monk!
scripts.translation:
[武僧学徒]
{0}……q.q..q. .放弃！ ……马拉松！！ 你……你没有成为武……武僧的资质！

scripts.text:
[Monk Apprentice]
Until you're told to stop,
Ru...ruu....run!
scripts.translation:
[武僧学徒]
直到有人叫你停，
跑……跑……跑！

scripts.text:
[Supervisor]
Now...you may go visit Tomoon.
Tomoon is in the deepest room inside a building near this abbey.
scripts.translation:
[主管]
现在……你可以去见托蒙了。
托蒙在这座修道院附近建筑物的最深处的房间里。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
You didn't bring enough mushrooms... go get some more.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
你带的香菇不够……再去采一些。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
Or is it you want to quit... do you want to quit?
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
还是说你想放弃……你想放弃吗？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
Then move!
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
那就动起来！

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
.....I figured as much....you don't have a spirit.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
……我就知道……你没有精神。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
Nice to meet you. My name is Hyunmoo. I am in charge of the mushroom test.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
很高兴认识你。我叫玄武。我负责香菇测试。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
Your task will be to gather mushrooms.
Understand?
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
你的任务是采集香菇。
明白了吗？

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
Picking the mushrooms is to train your tolerance.
We planted a garden in order to survive as well as to discipline our minds.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
采摘香菇是为了训练你的耐力。
我们种植花园既是为了生存，也是为了磨练心智。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
I believe there is no better way to find true inner peace then to be one with nature.
So we created our garden, however these mushrooms started sprouting up everywhere!
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
我相信没有比与自然合一来寻找内心平静更好的方法了。
所以我们创建了花园，然而这些香菇开始到处生长！

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
What we ask of you as part of your training is to remove these mushrooms.
Go help the others remove as many mushrooms as you can and bring me back
enough ^FF0000Orange Net Mushrooms^000000 and ^FF0000Orange Gooey Mushroom^000000 as proof.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
作为训练的一部分，我们要求你清除这些香菇。
去帮助其他人尽可能多地清除香菇，并带回足够的^FF0000毒香菇^000000和^FF0000恶臭香菇^000000作为证明。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
Now, go get some mushrooms.
Check back with me when you have picked some, I will tell you if it is enough.
And remember, find peace when gardening.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
现在，去采些香菇吧。
当你采了一些后回来找我，我会告诉你是否足够。
记住，在园艺中寻找平静。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
...or do you want to quit?
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
……还是说你想放弃？

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Yes.
scripts.translation: 是的。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
Alright then, keep going.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
好吧，那就继续。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
.....yeah I thought as much....you don't have the spirit needed to become a monk.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
……是的，我就知道……你没有成为武僧所需的精神。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
...hmm... not bad.
Ok, you passed.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
……嗯……不错。
好，你通过了。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
Go meet Tomoon for your next test.
Tomoon is staying in the deepest room inside a building near this abbey.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
去见托蒙进行下一项测试。
托蒙待在这座修道院附近建筑物的最深处房间里。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
Didn't I tell you to go meet ^FF0000Tomoon^000000? Or do you want to pick some more mushrooms?
Tomoon is staying in the deepest room inside a building near this abbey.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
我没告诉过你去见^FF0000托蒙^000000吗？还是你想再采些香菇？
托蒙待在这座修道院附近建筑物的最深处房间里。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
As I see vegetables growing, I feel myself growing within.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
看着蔬菜生长，我感到自己也在成长。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
As I see other monks working hard on growing vegetables,
it warms my heart to see others enjoying gardening as I do.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
看着其他武僧努力种植蔬菜，
看到别人像我一样享受园艺，让我心里温暖。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
To be honest with you, I think gardening is the greatest thing ever...
We should give thanks to the brothers who prepare our food for us through their hard work.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
老实说，我认为园艺是最伟大的事情……
我们应该感谢那些通过辛勤劳动为我们准备食物的兄弟们。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
Don't forget to thank them as you go by for their hard work.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
路过时别忘了感谢他们的辛勤工作。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
Didn't I tell you to go meet Tomoon? Or do you want to pick more mushrooms?
Tomoon is staying in the deepest room inside a building near this abbey.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
我没告诉过你去见托蒙吗？还是你想再采些香菇？
托蒙待在这座修道院附近建筑物的最深处房间里。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
As I see vegetables growing, I feel myself growing within.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
看着蔬菜生长，我感到自己也在成长。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
As I see other monks working hard on growing vegetables,
it warms my heart to see others enjoying gardening as I do.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
看着其他武僧努力种植蔬菜，
看到别人像我一样享受园艺，让我心里温暖。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
To be honest with you, I think gardening is the greatest thing ever...
We should give thanks to the brothers who prepare our food for us through their hard work.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
老实说，我认为园艺是最伟大的事情……
我们应该感谢那些通过辛勤劳动为我们准备食物的兄弟们。

scripts.text:
[Hyunmoo]
Don't forget to thank them as you go by for their hard work.
scripts.translation:
[玄武]
路过时别忘了感谢他们的辛勤工作。

scripts.text:
[Tomoon]
Welcome young one.
My name is Tomoon, I am in charge of the last test of spiritual training!
scripts.translation:
[托蒙]
欢迎，年轻人。
我叫托蒙，我负责精神训练的最后一项测试！

scripts.text:
[Tomoon]
Now you don't need to be instructed any more than this:
^990000Terminate every living thing in your way!^000000 That's all!
scripts.translation:
[托蒙]
现在你不需要更多的指示了：
^990000消灭挡在你面前的一切生灵！^000000 就是这样！

scripts.text:
[Tomoon]
While you're wandering around within the maze, if you encounter any evil creatures, just kill them! Release their tortured souls!!
scripts.translation:
[托蒙]
当你在迷宫中徘徊时，如果遇到邪恶生物，就杀死它们！释放它们受折磨的灵魂！！

scripts.text:
[Tomoon]
Do not compare us to the weakling priests! We are monks and we will always be the strongest!!
scripts.translation:
[托蒙]
不要把我们和软弱的牧师相提并论！我们是武僧，我们将永远是最强的！！

scripts.text:
[Tomoon]
We are not like priests who cower behind the strength of others!
scripts.translation:
[托蒙]
我们不像那些躲在他人力量背后的牧师！

scripts.text:
[Tomoon]
Now, focus!! Keep your fists tight and your eyes open! It's time to show me what you got.
scripts.translation:
[托蒙]
现在，集中精神！！握紧拳头，睁开眼睛！是时候向我展示你的实力了。

scripts.text:
[Tomoon]
Let's see if you got what it takes to be a true monk!!
scripts.translation:
[托蒙]
让我们看看你是否具备成为真正武僧的资质！！

scripts.text:
[Tomoon]
Hmm... you failed?
Cheer up! Failure is but a process to success!
Go! Start again! Kill them all!!
scripts.translation:
[托蒙]
嗯……你失败了？
振作起来！失败只是成功的过程！
去吧！重新开始！杀光他们！！

scripts.text:
[Tomoon]
Excellent job!!
I knew you'd make it through!
Now...I will give you a secret potion which will double your physical strength.
scripts.translation:
[托蒙]
干得漂亮！！
我就知道你能通过！
现在……我会给你一种秘密药水，能使你的体力加倍。

scripts.text:
Drink this potion and you will be able to become a monk!!!
... now go back to sensei Moohae!!!
scripts.translation:
喝下这瓶药水，你就能成为武僧！！！
……现在回武海师父那里去！！！

scripts.text:
[Tomoon]
I already told you, go back to sensei Moohae!!!
scripts.translation:
[托蒙]
我已经告诉过你了，回武海师父那里去！！！

scripts.text:
[Tomoon]
....be quiet.
.....

[Tomoon]
I will not allow anyone to cause any trouble in this abbey.
scripts.translation:
[托蒙]
我不允许任何人在这里惹麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Tomoon]
You'd better not be thinking about causing any trouble.
scripts.translation:
[托蒙]
你最好别想着惹麻烦。

scripts.text:
[Proctor]
So, are you ready to undergo the spiritual training?
scripts.translation:
[监考员]
那么，你准备好接受精神训练了吗？

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 是的！

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: What do I have to do?
scripts.translation: 我需要做什么？

scripts.text:
[Proctor]
Alright! I wish you luck. If you get lost and can't find a way out, simply log out and log back in.
Then you will return to your save point. What's that mean? Heck if I know, I'm just told to say that. Oh yes and also, please cooperate with your comrades.
scripts.translation:
[监考员]
好吧！祝你好运。如果你迷路了找不到出口，只需退出游戏重新登录。
然后你会回到存档点。这意味着什么？鬼才知道，我只是被告知这么说。哦对了，还有，请与你的同志合作。

scripts.text:
[Proctor]
I see. Take your time.
scripts.translation:
[监考员]
我明白了。慢慢来。

scripts.text:
[Proctor]
Inside this test hall is the maze of spirits.
There are spirits inside which will block you from moving freely.
scripts.translation:
[监考员]
这个测试大厅里是灵魂迷宫。
里面有会阻碍你自由移动的精灵。

scripts.text:
[Proctor]
If you want to exit the test hall, you must make your way to the warp portal located at the opposite side from the start point.
scripts.translation:
[监考员]
如果你想离开测试大厅，必须前往位于起点对面的传送之阵。

scripts.text:
[Proctor]
....Oh yes and also there are monsters wandering around in the maze, please clear them.
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[监考员]
……哦对了，迷宫里还有游荡的魔物，请清除它们。
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Proctor]
You did well. Please return to Tomoon, he's waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[监考员]
你做得很好。请回到托蒙那里，他在等你。

scripts.text:
[Proctor]
So, are you ready to undergo this spiritual training?
scripts.translation:
[监考员]
那么，你准备好接受这项精神训练了吗？

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 是的！

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Check the caution for the test.
scripts.translation: 查看测试注意事项。

I see. Take your time.

[监考员]
我明白了。慢慢来。

Good luck.

祝你好运。

scripts.translation:

你做得很好。请回到托蒙那里，他在等你。

scripts.text:
[Proctor]
So, are you ready to undergo this spiritual training?
scripts.translation:
[监考员]
那么，你准备好接受这项精神训练了吗？

scripts.text: Yes!
scripts.translation: 是的！

scripts.text: No.
scripts.translation: 不。

scripts.text: Check the caution for the test.
scripts.translation: 查看测试注意事项。

scripts.text:
[Proctor]
Alright! I wish you luck. If you get lost and can't find a way out, simply log out and log back in.
Then you will return to your save point. What's that mean? Heck if I know, I'm just told to say that. Oh yes and also, please cooperate with your comrades.
scripts.translation:
[监考员]
好吧！祝你好运。如果你迷路了找不到出口，只需退出游戏重新登录。
然后你会回到存档点。这意味着什么？鬼才知道，我只是被告知这么说。哦对了，还有，请与你的同志合作。

scripts.text:
[Proctor]
I see. Take your time.
scripts.translation:
[监考员]
我明白了。慢慢来。

scripts.text:
[Proctor]
Inside this test hall is the maze of spirits.
There are spirits inside which will block you from moving freely.
scripts.translation:
[监考员]
这个测试大厅里是灵魂迷宫。
里面有会阻碍你自由移动的精灵。

scripts.text:
[Proctor]
If you want to exit the test hall, you must make your way to the warp portal located at the opposite side from the start point.
scripts.translation:
[监考员]
如果你想离开测试大厅，必须前往位于起点对面的传送之阵。

scripts.text:
[Proctor]
....Oh yes and also there are monsters wandering around in the maze, please clear them.
Good luck.
scripts.translation:
[监考员]
……哦对了，迷宫里还有游荡的魔物，请清除它们。
祝你好运。

scripts.text:
[Proctor]
You did well. Please return to Tomoon, he's waiting for you.
scripts.translation:
[监考员]
你做得很好。请回到托蒙那里，他在等你。

scripts.text:
Grrrr...
All monsters in the monk job chance place have been reset.
Timer's activated.
scripts.translation:
咕噜噜……
武僧转职场所的所有魔物已重置。
计时器已启动。
